verdict.rationale: There is only a single thin mention that older CLI commands still work but emit a deprecation warning, implying some informal deprecation practice, plus a versioned docs path (v1-15-21) suggesting version-tagged releases — but no explicit documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and probes show no OpenAPI/API contract exists at all. Missing for 10: an explicit versioning policy document, a defined deprecation timeline/process, and a discoverable API spec (OpenAPI 404s in probe).
